scope: Read-only consolidation of frozen media-v17 independent review and consumer contract for the new v26-based media-v27 work. This does not assess or modify v27 implementation, and does not approve v17 deployment.

v17_disposition.closed_finding: pte-4g-carry only: independently encode each full-width physical page; stage2 boundary arithmetic tests passed.

minimum_gates.minimum: Clear PTE/L1 entries, publish device-visible contents, invalidate the affected TLB/PTW in both v20 instances, establish completion, then allow data/table reuse. Propagate failure and prevent unsafe reuse. Read/check both instances rather than returning instance0 alone.
minimum_gates.critical_limit: The existing set-delay10us-clear sequence is not proof of completion, and no version-correct completion semantics were established. Do not borrow v3 offsets/self-clear semantics. Delaying only L2 free is insufficient if stale translations can access recycled data pages.

minimum_gates.minimum: Use coherent DMA allocations or properly mapped table buffers with actual DMA handles and complete ownership/synchronization. Zero/synchronize L2 before publishing its L1 descriptor. Preserve32bitIOVA/34bitPA bounds and per-page high-bit encoding. Reject existing-PTE conflicts, propagate mapped length/error and roll back partially published allocation state.
minimum_gates.critical_limit: virt_to_phys is not a DMA mapping handle. A WARN plus overwrite or ignored map helper error cannot be deployed.

minimum_gates.minimum: Serialize shared domain/group creation and attach/detach ownership; fail allocation/attach on hardware-init errors. Quiesce or block all attached masters and remove their live TTB references before table destruction. Balance group/OF refs and remove unused notifier allocations.
minimum_gates.critical_limit: Do not free page tables while hardware can still walk them; do not cache ERR_PTR or publish a partially initialized singleton.

minimum_gates.minimum: Validate every iommus argument and explicitly own both VE masters6/7. Keep unrelated GPU/display/storage masters unchanged or initially bypassed as appropriate; the old0x3ff mask omitted masters10/11. Compare names for equality with NULL/unknown handling. Restrict fault bits to six valid masters per instance; validate nonzero/range before __ffs, array indexing, callbacks or master MMIO.
minimum_gates.critical_limit: Instance1 seventh-MIC decoding must not address master12. Fault/unknown bits must not be converted into a fabricated valid master.

minimum_gates.minimum: Use IS_ERR/PTR_ERR for MMIO resources; acquire and check runtime power, clocks and reset resources before MMIO. Balance failure unwind and publish globals only after complete initialization. Dual-instance resource integration must preserve shared GPU/display/storage gates and locks.
minimum_gates.critical_limit: Donor PM power timeout that merely prints or WARNs before returning success is not an acceptable provider contract.

minimum_gates.minimum: Cedar2.0 selects system dma-heap/IOMMU, which may supply discontiguous physical pages. Use full dma-buf attach/map/unmap/detach lifetime, validate a contiguous complete DMA-address extent and the32bit private-ioctl range, and hold mapping ownership while VE may access it.
minimum_gates.critical_limit: The first SG physical address is not a whole-buffer mapping. Plugin registration or heap availability alone does not establish real decode, encode, AFBC, zero-copy presentation or browser acceleration.

priority: Gate1 is the earliest unresolved hardware-contract dependency; gates2-5 are concrete source/resource correctness closures. Gate6 is required before handing system-heap buffers to Cedar/VE. These are deployment prerequisites, not a request for broad additional testing.
next_evidence: Each v27 closure should identify its exact implementation and supporting version-correct contract or observation; compile/host arithmetic success cannot substitute for missing DMA completion semantics.
